exposure: HCN3 genetic variants (c.1370G > A (R457H), c.1982G > A (R661Q), c.1982G > A(P630L))
cohort: The study included a cohort of 298 epilepsy patients.
finding: Two rare heterozygous HCN3 genetic variants (R457H and R661Q) significantly reduced current density, suggesting HCN3 as a novel candidate gene involved in epileptic disorders.
